title: Companion approval feedback is inconsistent: some choices produce an explicit '<Name> approves/disapproves' tag with a visible regard delta in the next status check, while others (e.g. declining to fight the ash wolf at Lys's request: 'Leave it. It isn't hunting — it's keeping something. We can go around.') produce no approval tag and no detectable regard change at all.
where: Twin Stones — sparing the ash wolf; general companion-regard system
